fact: The AfDB appraisal report says a 2.0 million UA grant would fund an integrated COTS tax software application with an e-services portal for taxpayer services, replacing the home-grown ERITAS, in Asmara's five tax offices.

An AfDB report of 19 May 2025 says a firm was recruited on 9 October 2024 to design, supply and install the Eritrea Integrated Tax Administration System, whose software and licences have been delivered, with equipment expected in Q3 2025.
